source.method: Nightly sweeps of open models on vendor GPUs with SGLang/vLLM/TRT-LLM (and AMD ATOM/MoRI); single-turn random 8k/1k and AgentX trace replay; tok/s/GPU vs tok/s/user across concurrency; cost = costh USD/GPU-h / (tok/s/GPU*3600/1e6).
source.terms: InferenceX repo Apache-2.0; results come from its public API (app repo GPL-3.0) with no separate data licence, so cited with attribution to SemiAnalysis.
